Explicit files and directories to create.

## file

| Key | Type | Default | Effect | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | — | Implemented | File name, relative to the project or directory. |
| `content` | string | — | Implemented | Inline file content. |
| `template` | string | — | No effect | Name of a template to render. **See KL-003.** |
| `source` | string | — | Implemented | Path to an existing file to copy. |
| `encoding` | string | `utf-8` | No effect | Character encoding of the written file. **See KL-005.** |

## directory

| Key | Type | Default | Effect | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | — | Implemented | Directory path relative to the project. May not contain `..`. |
| `files` | file[] | — | Implemented | Files to create inside the directory. |

:::caution[Known limitation]
**`file.template` has no effect and the file is created empty.** The key passes schema validation, but content resolution handles only `content` and `source`, so the file is written with no bytes.

Use `content:` for inline text, or `source:` for a path to an existing file to copy.

_Tracked as [KL-003](/reference/known-limitations/#kl-003) · Applies to CLI 1.2.1_
:::

:::note[Not yet implemented]
**`file.encoding` has no effect.** The key is parsed and validated. Files are always written as UTF-8.

None required for UTF-8 output. Convert the file in a `postScaffoldCommands` step if another encoding is needed.

_Tracked as [KL-005](/reference/known-limitations/#kl-005) · Applies to CLI 1.2.1_
:::
